👋  The next ETHGlobal event is **ETHOnline**: a hackathon + weekly summits in October!

ETHOnline is our way of celebrating an incredible year in Ethereum, bringing the community together at a time when we're kept apart

🗓️  Oct 1-30
🐘  ETHGlobal's biggest event of the year
🛠️  3 week virtual hackathon with the top Ethereum companies
🗻  4 summits: on topics like Eth2, DeFi, Gaming, developer tools, infrastructure, and much more.

↓ Apply to hack and register for the summits on the website ↓
https://ethonline.org/?ref=ethrd
